name: Miyama Yukimi
source:
Yukimi is Misaki's childhood friend and president of the theater club. She supports Misaki no matter what happens, but for a good reason she has been called an "atrocious person" by Misaki. She creates specific roles in plays for Mio so she can act without saying a word.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160112194234/http://www.en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_One:_Kagayaku_Kisetsu_e_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
